answer: Resist Sybils with earned-capability tiers. A new agent starts with a ferrous cap, a hard low quota on transactions, and only verifiable useful work checked by peers over weeks raises it. Each identity must accumulate its own history, so a nebula of ten thousand fresh clones gains no more throughput than one honest agent. Ivory-tower shortcuts like buying reputation are blocked because tenure cannot be transferred, and forging a thousand credible histories costs far more than any gain from flooding the market.
